The only validated edge is the absolute-trend drawdown gate (gate_helps=true), so this is a risk/de-risk lens, not a return forecast — the macro backdrop is geopolitics-dominant with very high unscheduled surprise share (0.88), which argues for humility.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Trend-gate leg says eligible leadership is intact and downside is capped by the only validated edge; rank 1 with a wide margin over the challenger means this is the prevailing narrative. Crowding (z=1.44, crowded=true) is a size-down caution only, not a fade, and hurst mean-revert plus breadth=0 says this is a narrow, fragile leader — so the lean is a cautious carry on the confirmed trend, not a chase.
evidence: trend-gate eligibility intact (the one validated leg)
margin 1.975 over challenger — leadership is confirmed, not contested
hurst_tag mean-revert, breadth 0.0 — narrow, fragile leadership
theses.dissent: Zero breadth and mean-reverting hurst mean the entire theme is a reflexivity-driven top: crowding flags mark tops in the guardrails, and a geopolitics-heavy macro backdrop with 88% unscheduled surprises can whipsaw any single narrow leader.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners shows the healthiest trend texture in the eligible set: hurst_tag trend, durability_bar 0.73 (highest in top 5), breadth 0.917, and uncrowded (z=0.22). This is a trend-gate-validated, broad, non-crowded leader that fits the staying-power leg better than the narrow memory theme.
evidence: durability_bar 0.73 — strongest durability in the top cohort
hurst_tag trend, breadth 0.917 — broad, persistent trend
theses.dissent: A mean-reverting macro regime (high unscheduled surprise share) hurts real-asset momentum names, and the detector's own momentum rank has no forward edge — the trend could roll over without warning.
